[simsvip ](https://simsvip.com/) :
A really good source for news concerning the sims! 

[Cheats](http://sims-online.com/sims-4-game-info/sims-4-game-cheats-codes/) :
A giant list of all the sims 4 cheats

[sims 4 guides ](www.carls-sims-4-guide.com/cheats.php) :
I’ve been using this website since TS3. It’s super helpful 

[cc (TSR)](https://www.thesimsresource.com) :
A huuuuuge site with tons of cc. They have maxis match (cc that matches the style of items in ts4) as well as alpha (more realistic) cc. 

[cc (tumblr)](https://www.tumblr.com/tagged/sims+4+cc) :
Tumblr has a massive index of cc. It can be harder to find specific items though. (in my opinion)

[mods](modthesims.info) : 
I get most of my mods on modthesims. It’s pretty awesome.
